lines.en: label sarasummer2bargen:
scene sarasummer2bargen
Another night means another chance to drink cheap beer and flirt with an attractive bartender while her daughter cleans glasses in the next room over.
lines.zh: 又一个夜晚，意味着又一次机会——喝着便宜的啤酒，跟一位迷人的酒保调情，而她女儿就在隔壁房间洗杯子。

lines.en: Thankfully, Sara is social enough that I don’t have to spend the majority of the night teaching her how to talk to people and, instead, am free to interact the way a normal human being does.
lines.zh: 好在 Sara 本来就够外向，我不必把大半个晚上都花在教她怎么跟人说话上，而是能像个正常人一样自在地相处。

lines.en: One of the things I like most about Sara is how naturally our conversations are able to form and how, despite having not known each other for very long, it feels like we’ve been together forever.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢 Sara 的一点，是我们之间的对话能那么自然地成形；明明认识没多久，却像是已经在一起一辈子了。

lines.en: I think for a moment about how things would be if I could go back in time and meet her there.
lines.zh: 我一时想着，要是能回到过去、在那时遇见她，会是什么样。

lines.en: About having an upperclassman two grades ahead of me who would pop into my classroom and steal me away from my friends.
lines.zh: 想着有个高我两届的学姐，会突然闯进教室，把我从朋友身边抢走。

lines.en: And about what the rooftop would look like if we were to sit down and eat lunch there.
lines.zh: 还有，要是我俩坐在天台上吃午饭，那会是什么光景。

lines.en: scene black
Throughout the night, a stream of customers come into the bar.
lines.zh: 一整晚，客人陆陆续续进了酒吧。

lines.en: It isn’t many, but it’s more than before. And it goes to show that Sara is trying her best, even if I don’t always see it.
lines.zh: 人不多，但比以前多了。这说明 Sara 在努力，尽管我不总能看见。

lines.en: Either that or Yuki is going out and intimidating people into coming here but, at this point, business is business.
lines.zh: 要么就是 Yuki 出去把人吓进来了；不过事到如今，生意就是生意。

lines.en: I accept the moments in which I need to be ignored in favor of furthering Sara’s return to the successful business-owner world and down several more drinks while she tends to other guests.
lines.zh: 我接受了那些「为了 Sara 重回成功老板之路，我得被晾在一边」的时刻，又灌下几杯，等她去照应别的客人。

lines.en: But she always comes back to me once she’s done with them.
lines.zh: 可她每次招呼完他们，总会回到我身边。

lines.en: And that’s far more than I deserve from her.
lines.zh: 这远远超出了我配从她那里得到的。

lines.zh: Sara 的好感度提升到了 [sara_love]!
